_about: Synthetic sample data for Fees & Billing screens (OBJ-23, with OBJ-03 enrolment and OBJ-04 guardian). All amounts, account numbers, receipts and the sponsor are invented and are NOT GIIS's real fees. Fee amounts, billing periods, tax, reminder steps and refund rules are each brand-country's or campus's own settings, never group defaults (DL-59 pattern, SR-FB-02). GIIS Singapore rules come from the GIIS Handbook 2025-26 (HB p.237-247). Reuses students and guardians from student-sample.json and applicants from admissions-sample.json. Viewer Siti Rahman, Finance Executive, SG-PGL; 'today' 14 Nov 2026. Billing periods are per programme offering (DL-96): CBSE/Cambridge/IGCSE Apr-Mar, IB DP Jul-May.
